description: This file defines an abstract class 'codeTrackerInterface' for connecting and interacting with code tracking systems within the TestLink project. It includes methods for configuration loading, database connection management, URL generation for code viewing, and other interface-related functionalities. It serves as a base class to be extended for specific code tracker implementations.

classes.name: codeTrackerInterface
classes.description: Abstract base class for code tracking interface implementations in TestLink, managing configuration, connection, and URL building for code review.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface with type, configuration, and name; sets charset, attempts configuration parsing, and connects to the system.

methods.name: setCfg
methods.description: Loads and parses the XML configuration string into a simplexml object, converting it to JSON for internal use.

methods.name: getMyInterface
methods.description: Returns the interface PHP configuration parameter.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes database connection based on configuration parameters.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns true if the connection to the code tracking system is active.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the database connection if active.

methods.name: buildViewCodeLink
methods.description: Generates an HTML link to view code in a new browser tab based on project, repository, code path, and optional branch/commit.

methods.name: getEnterCodeURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for entering or submitting new code links.

methods.name: buildViewCodeURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL to view code in the tracking system, with optional branch or commit specification.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to provide configuration template.

methods.name: checkEnv
methods.description: Checks environmental requirements for the class; defaults to always OK.
